# Reusable regression fixtures

Small deterministic files for browser/unit regression tests. They are deliberately tiny so they can live in the repository.

- `sample.png` — image upload/conversion fixture
- `sample.pdf` — valid one-page PDF fixture
- `sample.docx` — valid OOXML DOCX with two text paragraphs
- `sample.json` — valid structured JSON
- `sample.csv` — CSV with header/numeric/boolean values
- `sample.js` — code/compiler/developer-tool input
- `sample.txt` — general text fixture
- `sample.html` / `sample.md` — document conversion fixtures
